cases.prompt: A porous scaffold meets a yield-strength target but collapses under cyclic perfusion. Identify two failure mechanisms missed by a one-time compression test and propose an accelerated but interpretable test plan.

rubric.criterion: Identifies fatigue, creep, degradation, buckling, or strut damage
Includes relevant wet/37°C or degradation environment
Specifies cyclic loading, controls, measured stiffness/porosity/flow, and stopping criteria

limitations: This preserved three-criterion checklist is self-assessment, not an analytic grading rubric or an institutional grade.

cases.prompt: Beam project milestone 1 (suggested week 8). Draw the free-body diagram of the 0.300 m simply supported beam with its 30 N midspan load, and calculate the support reactions and the maximum bending moment.

rubric.criterion: I drew both supports with ideal reactions and the load at midspan.
I found the reactions from force and moment balance, not by assuming symmetry alone.
I calculated the maximum bending moment with units of N·m.
I checked my method on the open rehearsal before using the project beam.

limitations: Optional self-check for the beam strength-and-stiffness project. The response is saved privately and is never submitted, scored or graded; the separate inactive project draft and its proposed rubric remain unreviewed.

cases.prompt: Beam project milestone 2 (suggested week 8). Convert every candidate property to SI units and calculate I, the maximum bending stress and the midspan deflection for candidates A, B and C.

rubric.criterion: I converted millimetres, gigapascals and megapascals to consistent SI units before calculating.
I used I = bh³/12 with the depth cubed and the width to the first power.
I calculated σ_max = 6M_max/(bh²) and δ_max = FL³/(48EI) for each candidate.
I kept enough digits to compare each result with its criterion.

limitations: Optional self-check for the beam strength-and-stiffness project. The response is saved privately and is never submitted, scored or graded; the separate inactive project draft and its proposed rubric remain unreviewed.

rubric.criterion: I applied the two criteria separately for every candidate.
I identified which candidates pass the strength check and which pass the stiffness check.
I explained why a beam can be strong enough and still too flexible.
